method: Three deterministic unittest cases execute real fault-server stdio through the SDK and actual /chat route. Only external model HTTP responses are mocked. The same session receives a filesystem recovery request after each fault.

checks.observed: Real fault_probe call emitted tool_error; the SDK delivered the sanitized failure to the controlled model. The response did not claim a retrieved status.
checks.recovery_observed: Real filesystem read_text_file returned the correct first line of notes.txt in the same session.
